title: 第17课 · 谁都有办法看好你的“病”
subtitle: HSK 3 · Lesson 17 — 谁都有办法看好你的“病” · Everybody is able to cure your "disease"

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在公司 — In the company

items.zh: 请假
items.py: qǐng jià
items.en: to ask for leave

items.zh: 一共
items.py: yígòng
items.en: in total

items.zh: 小丽：周经理，下个星期我可以请几天假吗？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Zhōu jīnglǐ, xià ge xīngqī wǒ kěyǐ qǐng jǐ tiān jià ma?
items.en: Xiaoli: Manager Zhou, may I take a few days off next week?

items.zh: 周明：你有什么事？
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Nǐ yǒu shénme shì?
items.en: Zhou Ming: What's the matter?

items.zh: 小丽：我的一个老朋友结婚，我跟他两年没见了。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Wǒ de yī ge lǎo péngyou jié hūn, wǒ gēn tā liǎng nián méi jiàn le.
items.en: Xiaoli: An old friend of mine is getting married, and I haven't seen him for two years.

items.zh: 周明：你一共想请几天假？
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Nǐ yīgòng xiǎng qǐng jǐ tiān jià?
items.en: Zhou Ming: How many days off do you want in total?

items.zh: 小丽：三天。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Sān tiān.
items.en: Xiaoli: Three days.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在公司 — In the company

items.zh: 邻居
items.py: línjū
items.en: neighbour

items.zh: 后来
items.py: hòulái
items.en: later, afterwards

items.zh: 爱好
items.py: àihào
items.en: hobby, interest

items.zh: 同事：小丽，那个高高的男人是你们公司的吗？你对他了解吗？
items.py: Tóngshì: Xiǎolì, nàge gāogāo de nánrén shì nǐmen gōngsī de ma? Nǐ duì tā liǎojiě ma?
items.en: Colleague: Xiaoli, is that tall man from your company? Do you know much about him?

items.zh: 小丽：我们过去是邻居，后来是大学同学，关系一直很不错。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Wǒmen guòqù shì línjū, hòulái shì dàxué tóngxué, guānxì yīzhí hěn bùcuò.
items.en: Xiaoli: We used to be neighbours, later we were university classmates, and we've always got on very well.

items.zh: 同事：他一般喜欢做什么？
items.py: Tóngshì: Tā yībān xǐhuan zuò shénme?
items.en: Colleague: What does he usually like to do?

items.zh: 小丽：他有很多爱好，唱歌、画画儿、踢足球，什么都会。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Tā yǒu hěn duō àihào, chàng gē, huà huàr, tī zúqiú, shénme dōu huì.
items.en: Xiaoli: He has lots of hobbies — singing, drawing, playing football; he can do everything.

items.zh: 同事：真的？那你介绍我们认识认识吧。
items.py: Tóngshì: Zhēn de? Nà nǐ jièshào wǒmen rènshi rènshi ba.
items.en: Colleague: Really? Then introduce us to each other.

items.zh: 小丽：不行，现在他是我丈夫。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Bù xíng, xiànzài tā shì wǒ zhàngfu.
items.en: Xiaoli: No way, he's my husband now.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在家 — At home

items.zh: 办法
items.py: bànfǎ
items.en: way, approach

items.zh: 饱
items.py: bǎo
items.en: full, having eaten one's fill

items.zh: 为了
items.py: wèile
items.en: for the sake of

items.zh: 决定
items.py: juédìng
items.en: to decide

items.zh: 周太太：最近我觉得哪儿都不舒服，你带我去医院检查检查吧。
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Zuìjìn wǒ juéde nǎr dōu bù shūfu, nǐ dài wǒ qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá jiǎnchá ba.
items.en: Mrs Zhou: Lately I feel unwell all over. Take me to the hospital for a check-up.

items.zh: 周明：不用去医院，谁都有办法看好你的“病”。我问你，你多久没运动了？
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Bù yòng qù yīyuàn, shéi dōu yǒu bànfǎ kànhǎo nǐ de “bìng”. Wǒ wèn nǐ, nǐ duō jiǔ méi yùndòng le?
items.en: Zhou Ming: No need to go to the hospital — anyone can cure your "illness". Let me ask you: how long is it since you last exercised?

items.zh: 周太太：我三年没运动了。
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Wǒ sān nián méi yùndòng le.
items.en: Mrs Zhou: I haven't exercised for three years.

items.zh: 周明：谁都知道运动对身体好。但是你吃饱了就睡。
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Shéi dōu zhīdào yùndòng duì shēntǐ hǎo. Dànshì nǐ chībǎo le jiù shuì.
items.en: Zhou Ming: Everyone knows exercise is good for your health. But you go to sleep as soon as you've eaten your fill.

items.zh: 周太太：为了健康，我真应该多锻炼锻炼了。从明天起，我决定每天去长跑。
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Wèile jiànkāng, wǒ zhēn yīnggāi duō duànliàn duànliàn le. Cóng míngtiān qǐ, wǒ juédìng měi tiān qù chángpǎo.
items.en: Mrs Zhou: For my health, I really should exercise more. Starting tomorrow, I've decided to go for a long run every day.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 短文 — How to exercise

items.zh: 选择
items.py: xuǎnzé
items.en: to choose

items.zh: 冬（天）
items.py: dōng (tiān)
items.en: winter

items.zh: 必须
items.py: bìxū
items.en: must

items.zh: 根据
items.py: gēnjù
items.en: according to, based on

items.zh: 情况
items.py: qíngkuàng
items.en: condition, situation

items.zh: 口
items.py: kǒu
items.en: mouth

items.zh: 渴
items.py: kě
items.en: thirsty

items.zh: “运动很重要”这句话谁都懂。
items.py: “Yùndòng hěn zhòngyào” zhè jù huà shéi dōu dǒng.
items.en: Everyone understands the saying "exercise is important".

items.zh: 但是你知道怎么运动吗？
items.py: Dànshì nǐ zhīdào zěnme yùndòng ma?
items.en: But do you know how to exercise?

items.zh: 第一，要选择“对”的时间。
items.py: Dì yī, yào xuǎnzé “duì” de shíjiān.
items.en: First, you should choose the "right" time.

items.zh: 一般来说，早上9点是最好的时间，冬天要再晚一些。
items.py: Yībān lái shuō, zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn shì zuì hǎo de shíjiān, dōngtiān yào zài wǎn yīxiē.
items.en: Generally speaking, 9 a.m. is the best time; in winter it should be a bit later.

items.zh: 第二，要选择“对”的地点，公园、山上、游泳馆，这些地方都可以运动。
items.py: Dì èr, yào xuǎnzé “duì” de dìdiǎn, gōngyuán, shān shang, yóuyǒngguǎn, zhèxiē dìfang dōu kěyǐ yùndòng.
items.en: Second, you should choose the "right" place — parks, mountains, swimming pools are all places where you can exercise.

items.zh: 第三，必须要根据自己的健康情况运动。
items.py: Dì sān, bìxū yào gēnjù zìjǐ de jiànkāng qíngkuàng yùndòng.
items.en: Third, you must exercise according to your own state of health.

items.zh: 如果你很久没爬山或者游泳了，运动一会儿就一定要休息休息。
items.py: Rúguǒ nǐ hěn jiǔ méi pá shān huòzhě yóu yǒng le, yùndòng yīhuìr jiù yīdìng yào xiūxi xiūxi.
items.en: If you haven't climbed a mountain or gone swimming for a long time, you must take a rest after exercising for a little while.

items.zh: 还要记得刚运动完口渴的时候，不要马上喝水。
items.py: Hái yào jìde gāng yùndòng wán kǒu kě de shíhou, bù yào mǎshàng hē shuǐ.
items.en: Also remember: when you're thirsty right after exercising, don't drink water straight away.
